description: This Java class defines an Android Fragment named AppRestrictionEnforcerFragment that provides a UI for setting application restrictions related to the AppRestrictionSchema. It manages various restriction types such as booleans, strings, integers, choices, multi-selects, and bundle arrays, and interacts with Android's RestrictionsManager and DevicePolicyManager to apply restrictions.

classes.name: AppRestrictionEnforcerFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that provides UI controls and logic to set and manage application restrictions for the AppRestrictionSchema, including handling various restriction types and persisting them.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI component references after view creation.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Loads restrictions when the fragment resumes.

methods.name: onCheckedChanged
methods.description: Handles toggle events for switches, updating restrictions accordingly.

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection events for spinners, updating restrictions.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button clicks for adding/removing items.

methods.name: onItemAdded
methods.description: Callback for adding new items to restrictions.

methods.name: loadRestrictions
methods.description: Retrieves and applies restrictions from RestrictionsManager and SharedPreferences.

methods.name: updateCanSayHello
methods.description: Updates UI and internal state for boolean restriction.

methods.name: updateMessage
methods.description: Updates UI and internal state for string restriction.

methods.name: updateNumber
methods.description: Updates UI and internal state for integer restriction.

methods.name: updateRank
methods.description: Updates UI and internal state for choice restriction.

methods.name: updateApprovals
methods.description: Updates UI and internal state for multi-select restrictions.

methods.name: updateItems
methods.description: Updates UI and internal state for bundle array restrictions.

methods.name: insertItemRow
methods.description: Adds a UI row for an item in the bundle array restrictions.

methods.name: convertToBundles
methods.description: Converts a Map of items to an array of Bundles for restrictions.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the bundle array restrictions.

methods.name: saveCanSayHello
methods.description: Saves boolean restriction to internal state and preferences.

methods.name: saveMessage
methods.description: Saves string restriction to internal state and preferences.

methods.name: saveNumber
methods.description: Saves integer restriction to internal state and preferences.

methods.name: saveRank
methods.description: Saves choice restriction to internal state and preferences.

methods.name: addApproval
methods.description: Adds an approval to the multi-select restriction.

methods.name: removeApproval
methods.description: Removes an approval from the multi-select restriction.

methods.name: saveApprovals
methods.description: Saves multi-select approvals to internal state and preferences.

methods.name: saveItems
methods.description: Saves bundle array items to internal state and preferences.

methods.name: saveRestrictions
methods.description: Applies current restrictions via DevicePolicyManager.

methods.name: editPreferences
methods.description: Returns SharedPreferences editor for storing restrictions.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a sequential search in a string array.
